description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'I18NImportErrorSearchFilterParams' used for specifying filter parameters when searching for internationalization import errors, including properties for language ID and employee number, and logic for setting default sorting field.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class extending FilterParams, used to encapsulate filter criteria such as language ID and employee number for searching import errors related to internationalization.

properties.name: ALLOWED_SORT_FIELDS
properties.description: A constant array defining allowed fields for sorting, specifically 'importError.langString'.

properties.name: languageId
properties.description: Property representing the ID of the language used in filtering.

properties.name: empNumber
properties.description: Property representing the employee number used in filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that sets the default sort field to 'importError.langString'.
